description: Ed25519 public keys used to sign the records of the Arcaeon witness case protocol (arcaeon-case/1). Sealed cases, withdrawal records and reference rows are signed by a case key (role case, or no role). A reconcile key (role reconcile), once this document lists one active, signs each sealed case's reconcile receipt and each refusal receipt; while this document lists no active reconcile key, this service seals no case and issues no refusal receipt (it answers sealing_not_offered). Each signed record names its key in signed_by and the commit of this document it was signed under in signed_under. signed_by is the key id <key name>+<8 hex>; find that key id here, in that role, and check the record's signature with the verifier string beside it. The signature is Ed25519 over the json-c14n:v1 bytes of the whole record minus sig. One public key is listed once, in one role: a case key is never the witness log's key or a reconcile key.
matching: Match on key_id, then use verifier: <key name>+<8 lowercase hex of sha256(name || 0x0a || 0x01 || public key)[0:4]>+<base64(0x01 || 32-byte Ed25519 public key)>, the signed-note verifier format of the witness log. key_id is the verifier without its base64 tail. Compare key bytes, not names.

status_meaning.active: Listed for its role. A record this key signed verifies under a document that lists it active.
status_meaning.revoked: Its private half is believed exposed. A record this key signed is not shown as holding, whenever it was signed: this document does not order a signature against a revocation.

rotation: Rotation adds a new key with status active. The previous key stays listed active with a note that it no longer signs, so the records it signed keep verifying. A key is marked revoked only if its private half is believed exposed. Dates in this document are information and are not enforced. A reader keeps a record to the document it names, at a commit on this repository's published branch, and each key that signed it must also be listed here, in its role, when the record is read. The service signs only with a key listed here as active in its role, and before it seals it confirms that this document is the one at the commit it names.

keys.note: arcaeon witness case signing key, minted 2026-10-10 on the owner's laptop
